title: A short start for a hard task
description: Pick a short stretch, turn on a background that suits you and get a calm summary after the session.

blocks.text: A person picks a hard task and a short stretch they can manage. A familiar background can be added, and after the session a small summary or a character’s reaction can be seen. Getting ready should not turn into a separate task.

quote.text: I’ve been using Brain.fm for almost 2 years now and I can’t recommend it enough for those with ADHD or just generally have trouble focusing on tasks. Personally I find regular music too distracting and silence makes my brain too loud.

blocks.text: It is worth starting with a saved duration and a single action to launch. The reward comes after the session and the background can be switched off; both elements are tested separately, to see what actually helps a particular user get started.

Reviews reflect personal experience of concentration, not a therapeutic effect. For testing the idea, whether the person started the task they chose and was able to carry on matters more than the time spent among the app’s animations.
